348:t_032:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I won't let you keep spreading your poison!」

348:t_033:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, hold position. Be ready to respond immediately, whatever happens.」

348:t_100:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$揺れる天秤$$...! You're challenging me again without learning your lesson!」

348:t_100:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Sorry to disappoint you. I'm not your beloved $$セツコ$$.」

348:t_100:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I know all about your obsession with $$セツコ$$!」

348:t_100:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Is that supposed to provoke me, $$クロウ・ブルースト$$?」

348:t_100:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Quit looking down on us. I'm just here to pay you back for $$クラヴィア$$.」

348:t_100:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Get ready, $$バルビエル$$! I'll beat you for $$クラヴィア$$!」

348:t_101:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$いがみ合う双子$$...! I can't hand you over to him!」

348:t_101:1.en:
$n
「I don't belong to anyone...! I won't let you do whatever you want with me, either!」

348:t_101:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Will you still say that after you taste my poison?」

348:t_101:3.en:
$n
「So you're relying on poison after all. You can't handle a fair fight head-on.」

348:t_101:5.en:
$n
「Try it if you can! Don't think your cowardly tricks can beat me!」

348:t_102:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I can see you're shaken, $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$. ...I can hardly blame you.」

348:t_102:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That hesitation will kill you...! You've lost, $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$!」

348:t_103:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You really did a number on me at $$ラース・バビロン$$, cursed wanderer...!」

348:t_103:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$怨嗟の魔蠍$$... Hatred gives you strength...」

348:t_103:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I could probably make better use of that $$スフィア$$.」

348:t_104:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What sun? You're just lashing out in hatred at those who twisted your family's fate.」

348:t_104:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What are you talking about...!?」

348:t_104:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「I won't become a $$メガノイド$$ bound by ego...! So I have no intention of fighting for revenge!」

348:t_104:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「The sun is with me! Anyone who would shroud the world in darkness will face me, $$破嵐万丈$$, and $$ダイターン３$$!」

348:t_105:0.en:
$$万丈$$
(The battle with the $$メガノイド$$s is over... But $$クロノ$$ was behind it...)

348:t_105:1.en:
$$万丈$$
(...My revenge is over... From here on, I'll devote my life to humanity's future.)

348:t_105:2.en:
$$万丈$$
(The future will come without us becoming $$メガノイド$$s...! I'll prove it!)

348:t_106:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That is why I fight...! To free you and bring peace to the universe!」

348:t_107:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「The four $$スフィア$$s within me...」

348:t_107:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Soon I'll know... how to use this power...」

348:t_108:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
(The settlements on $$火星$$ are at our backs... If we lose here, I won't be able to face $$ユーサー$$...)

348:t_108:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
(And if I screw up, that monster cat might really come back to haunt me...!)
